scope: Versioned operational source repair, not a model-search or predictive-accuracy study. Existing daily/weekly/grading scheduler only. Reference recent/pooled methods; no selected challenger or production promotion.

players.name: players.parquet
players.purpose: Exact source identity only; no PFR-derived participation or snap features

rosters.name: roster_weekly_{season}.parquet
rosters.purpose: Opportunity membership only; ACT/INA is not game participation

license.name: nflverse_LICENSE.md
license.purpose: Hosting license receipt, not a blanket upstream grant

excluded_source_families: NGS/news/weather in this operational source variant

history.prior_filter_rule: Read schedule metadata only. Include a season/week only when every scheduled REG game in that week has kickoff+7days strictly before supplied actual asof. Push exact OR season/week/game_type filters into stats and roster parquet reads BEFORE statistic values are loaded. Keep schedule metadata for identity/future population separately; never scores.
history.source_seasons: Explicit supported input seasons, 2012 through supplied NFL active season; active season may differ from UTC year in January.
history.protected_confirmation: During software/cache acceptance read at most2026Weeks1-5; no2026W8+ outcomes while tuning. Future operational use of earlier weeks is allowed only under this frozen source/training policy after availability/cutoff gates, never hyperparameter selection.
history.participation: Reuse unchanged qualify_history: supported positive physical official event establishes playing; zero-only/missing/ACT/INA rows stay unknown and remain rolling slots. Separate existing supported final-provider DNP grading may be retained.
history.scoring: Signed yardage and supported count zeros preserved; missing fields not zero. Exact website PPR remains blocked without full label contract.
history.publication_times: Known local receipt clocks retained. Historical availability kickoff+7days is an explicit reconstruction assumption, not authenticated upstream publication.

namespaces.isolation: Immutable copied source bodies with original receipts under sources; independently hashed filtered raw views and subset manifests; no symlinks. No writes to prior source cache/frozen processed outputs. Reject forbidden/unexpected raw artifacts before shared normalizer.
namespaces.identity: Policy+new adapter+shared transform code hashes+original source/receipt hashes+exact subset filters/hashes+qualified training-view hash must bind input/model/artifact namespace. New reference source/model versions, never old PFR-trained cache reuse.

operational_routing.source_policy: Explicit --source-policy config/operational-source-policy-v1.json in existing workflow; CLI current operations default to same safe policy or require it, no silent legacy fallback.
operational_routing.weekly_search: Original config/research.json finite candidate/search/split budget remains frozen. This packet executes no new weekly research campaign.
operational_routing.failure: Affected new issuance/training abstains with explicit failure; preserve earlier immutable forecasts and continue grading/replay. Never fall back to forbidden legacy loader.
operational_routing.grading: Primary saved Sleeper final/correction contract unchanged. Supplemental NFL cache fallback uses the same permitted source policy; no new snap source reads. Do not rewrite prior corrections.
operational_routing.frozen_records: rec-half source/registration/Weeks7-14 remain separately owned, no recorder/backfill/restart. Original RB protocol and PPR gates unchanged.

budgets.later_reference_runtime: Must separately freeze exact code/input/query versions and a bounded22-package recent/pooled verification before any real reference fitting/inference. Actual hosted run requires accepted code/checks; no website run. This plan alone does not claim activation.
budgets.network_acquisition: No new HTTP in local acceptance. Operational acquisition reuses existing bounded downloader at most3attempts/URL,2threads,512MiBtotal bodies and dailyonce refresh. Wire a hard outer daily/weekly job cap; retain failures.
budgets.technical_repairs: At most one separately registered zero-fit cache acceptance repair within unspent cumulative limits; preserve original failure marker. Import-only capability preflight before consuming invocation.

software_acceptance: No PFR file request/read even if poisoned snap file exists in old cache
Before-stat-read filters and no protected outcome reads
Explicit played-zero/missing/DNP/unknown and signed yard semantics
No legacy selected methods/model cache reuse in policy path
All operational commands and grading failure/retry/idempotency/replay paths use source policy
Training view/code/source hashes bound and frozen input files unchanged
Season rollover Januaryactiveyear vs UTCyear and REG/Post behavior
Single scheduler/resource/retention controls and website unchanged
public_export: Reviewed code/fictional tests/config plus derived aggregate receipts/hashes only; no raw sources/player rows/model weights.
evidence_lane: Software acceptance and current-vintage source reconstruction only; zero new independent-confirmation samples.
